html:
What is beautiful about Ninh Binh tourism in September is a question that many tourists are interested in, because this is the time when the weather in the North is starting to gradually change from autumn to winter, a cool scene that is very suitable for tourists’ tours. Because many tourists often choose to travel to Ninh Binh in September.

Ninth Binh tourism in September, visitors will be immersed in the beautiful natural scenery, Ninh Binh is a destination that attracts visitors all year round, however, coming to Ninh Binh in September, visitors will admire the idyllic scenery, the rice flowers, the lotus flowers blooming with fragrant scent, let’s explore the beautiful tourist destinations in Ninh Binh in September with Vietlook Travel through this article.

The weather in Ninh Binh in September will range from 21 to 27 degrees Celsius, which is a suitable temperature for visitors to visit and immerse themselves in the autumn weather.

Ninh Binh in September has lotus flowers exuding a fragrant scent in the wind, which is also the time when visitors come to take virtual photos with the fragrant lotus season, interspersed with the fragrant scent of rice in the wind of a ripe rice season.

Tam Coc – Bich Dong

One of the indispensable destinations in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary, famous for its mysterious caves surrounded by towering limestone mountains and beautiful landscapes, a beautiful destination in the autumn weather of Ninh Binh.

Trang An

Coming here, visitors will encounter winding rivers, not only a virtual living spot sought by many tourists, but also a place for visitors to experience beautiful sightseeing, especially in the autumn weather, there is nothing more interesting.

Tuyet Tinh Coc

A poetic beauty surrounded by rows of green trees and limestone mountains, Tuyet Tinh Coc in September will bring visitors a poetic and romantic beauty with a clear blue lake like jade, a peaceful scene chosen by many tourists as a virtual living spot, when going on a tour of Ninh Binh in September.

Hoa Lu

A magnificent beauty, with its own design and a place with a unique historical and cultural mark, when traveling to Hoa Lu in September, visitors will feel the natural scenery blending together to create a poetic picture.

Hang Mua

Traveling to Hang Mua in September is truly an unforgettable memory, not only experiencing but also conquering the stone road, reaching the top, visitors will be able to see the whole beauty of Ninh Binh from above.

Nho Quan Pine Hill

A virtual living spot sought by many tourists, especially those who love natural scenery and want to immerse themselves in a peaceful setting, enjoy an interesting vacation, especially those traveling in groups who can camp overnight to enjoy the fresh air.

Bai Dinh Pagoda

A spiritual pagoda that cannot be missed when traveling to Ninh Binh, no matter what season of the year, when coming to Ninh Binh, visitors visit Bai Dinh Pagoda and offer incense to pray for health, peace…

In the cool air and cool weather, it will bring visitors an exciting adventure, not only sightseeing but also experiencing cycling to admire the beautiful landscape.

Dong Thai Lake

If you travel to Ninh Binh in September, you definitely cannot miss a destination like Dong Thai Lake, a quiet space with clear blue water surrounded by undulating limestone ranges, visitors can camp right below to experience the poetic scenery together, and save for themselves beautiful souvenir photos.

Thung Nang

With its peaceful beauty, on the lake surface are blooming lotus flowers, many visitors choose Thung Nang as a virtual living spot when coming to Ninh Binh in September.

Delicious dishes not to be missed when traveling to Ninh Binh in September

Eel fish salad

An attractive dish in Ninh Binh, the fish is carefully selected by the people, the fish meat is firm and fragrant, the fish must be fresh and delicious when processed, after enjoying, diners eat it with leaves such as: guava leaves, perilla leaves, basil, ginseng, mint, green banana, … with dipping sauce to bring a delicious and attractive flavor.

Mountain goat meat

A dish not to be missed when coming to Ninh Binh, the goats here are raised naturally so they are very delicious, and are prepared by professional chefs to bring diners an irresistible aroma.
